results.statement: dev-sanity must spawn the sanity-stack subagent for the link whenever more than one sanity task is open (or its own inline link failed), one spawn at a time in verdict order; each spawn handles exactly one next-top layer and the close procedure runs only after it returns stacked.
results.quote: we should create a sanity-stack subagent.  IF more than 1 sanity tasks are queued, sanity agent MUST use santiy-stack subagent to do the stacking and after successful stack run the close procedure.  the sanity-stack subagent should handle a single next-top layer.  multiple sanity complete sanity-stack agent spawns must be done sequentially.  This should keep things from falling apart when 10 sanity tasks land at the same time. ... dealing with the 'race condition' is the most important thing the agent does.
results.context: phase-bj planning 2026-10-18 (second round): Rand's sanity-stack, stack bead and lock rulings (atm-bd-orchestration PR #342, docs/requirements/sanity-stack.md)
results.deterministic_check: dev-sanity.md forbids a second sanity-stack spawn while one is running; sanity-stack.md takes one checked bead per input; ten simultaneous PASSes in a scratch run produce ten sequential link events in the stack bead history
